en.title: Apple Price Hikes & Antitrust Woes Drive Bearish Outlook
en.summary: The probability of Apple (AAPL) hitting a low of $280 by June 29, 2026, surged to 100%, reflecting strong bearish sentiment. This movement was primarily driven by news of 'Massive Apple Price Increases' and an 'antitrust investigation' in India.
drivers: Massive Apple product price increases reported.
Antitrust investigation in India intensifies.
en.why_matters: These events signal potential revenue headwinds from reduced demand and significant legal/regulatory risks, impacting Apple's long-term profitability and market access.
en.bull_case: Continued consumer resistance to price hikes and escalating global antitrust scrutiny will depress AAPL's valuation.
en.bear_case: Apple's strong brand loyalty and successful legal defense could mitigate risks, preventing a $280 low.

zh.title: 苹果涨价与反垄断，股价承压
zh.summary: 苹果(AAPL)在2026年6月29日当周触及280美元低点的可能性飙升至100%，反映出强烈的看跌情绪。这主要受“苹果产品大幅涨价”和在印度面临“反垄断调查”新闻的驱动。
drivers: 苹果产品价格大幅上涨。
印度反垄断调查加剧。
zh.why_matters: 这些事件预示着需求减少可能导致营收逆风，以及重大的法律和监管风险，影响苹果的长期盈利能力和市场准入。
zh.bull_case: 消费者对高价产品抵制，加上全球反垄断审查升级，将持续压低苹果估值。
zh.bear_case: 苹果强大的品牌忠诚度及成功辩护，或能缓解风险，避免股价跌至280美元。
